_comment: Creative Commons audio fixtures from Wikimedia Commons, used to exercise the analysis
and decode pipelines on real-world material across genres and tempos (house, disco,
hip-hop, lofi, electronic, neurofunk, and classical).
These files are FETCHED AT TEST TIME by scripts/download-fixtures.sh and are NEVER
committed (see .gitignore, ATTRIBUTION.md). License/author for each are on the linked
The library decodes every fixture format NATIVELY (flac->libFLAC, ogg->stb_vorbis,
opus->libopusfile, mp3->Apple), so no ffmpeg/transcode step is required: each fixture
also serves as a real decode-path test for its container.
'expected' values are null until a developer verifies them by ear/reference. While null,
real-fixture tests assert DETERMINISM + PLAUSIBILITY (BPM within [60,190], valid key,
confidence > floor). Fill an expected.bpm/expected.key to promote a track to a strict
Phase 5 (audio-engine unification): the tempo/key estimators were replaced by the
Accelerate pipeline ported from parso-tonearm. Strict expected.bpm/expected.key values
the ported estimator did not reproduce were reset to null pending the author's perceptual
re-verification; where a track-level 'note' recorded a human reference, that note is kept.
